decision: Reopen the ratified entry segment (OD-M-05) in light of switching evidence
options: Keep OD-M-05 | Re-platforming community and faith foundations via partner | Channel-partner licensing | Evidence-first non-custodial services then licensing
recommendation: Keep OD-M-05 as a long-term destination; enter partner-first (module inside a channel partner offering) then licence; administration only behind an anchor
clarity_readiness: Not ready: no owner acceptance of measures or dates
deadline_trigger: Before further platform build beyond Release 1 scope

decision: Do not form a custodial full-service DAF administrator as the entry vehicle
options: Form now | Form only behind an anchor design partner | Never
recommendation: Form only behind a signed anchor ($0.5-1.0B) after licensing evidence
evidence_needed: Design-partner LOI; counsel opinion; auditor conversation

decision: Replace the 180-day full re-review policy (a policy choice, not law) with change-driven re-vetting and evidence expiry as the design target
options: Full periodic | Change-driven with expiry | Hybrid sample
recommendation: Change-driven with expiry plus a statistical sample audit
clarity_readiness: Partly ready: design evidence exists; auditor view missing
evidence_needed: Replay harness (V-3); counsel review of 180-day decision record

decision: Exclude non-redistributable sources (ProPublica GivingTuesday OpenSanctions EMMA BBB) from any shared or resold intelligence layer
recommendation: Exclude from shared/resold layer; allow link-out

decision: Treat AI-generated assessments as advisory records that can never become authoritative facts without a deterministic rule or a named human decision
options: Advisory only | Allow promotion by confidence threshold

decision: Price the first product as a licence or service with published terms rather than a 20 bps administration fee
options: 20 bps admin | Per-account licence ($81-150) | Service subscription
recommendation: Per-account licence or subscription; bps only for administration later

decision: Cluster first migrations on one incumbent source (e.g. NPact/FIMS legacy or iPhi community foundations) to amortise one adapter
deadline_trigger: Before first migration package beyond canonical import

decision: Fund only the evidence gates (G0-G2 about $0.35-0.75M) before committing platform capital
options: Fund full build now | Fund gates first
recommendation: Fund G0 ($0.15-0.35M) then G1 partner pilot ($1.0-1.5M cumulative) before platform capital; kill rule: no named partner by month 6 or no referenceable pilot by month 24

decision: Do not build a proprietary charity payment network or charity-facing portal requirement
recommendation: Partner rails + sponsor ACH (consistent with CNV-LEG-001)

decision: Make published migration outcome and exit-symmetry commitments a commercial term only after one measured rehearsal on a real export
recommendation: Offer process SLAs only (capped liability) and only after one measured rehearsal

decision: Keep Transitus phase-1 scope (canonical import; basic packages; reconciliation gates) and defer vendor-specific packages until a customer-authorised sample exists
recommendation: Keep phase 1 (consistent with D-MIT-002 revised and DF-TRN-2026-0019)

decision: Run the 10-perspective adversarial findings' top five tests as the commercial validation plan
